{"notes": "Visit 4 (left at 8:30). Only the facilitator spoke, announcing 2 minutes left. None of the four said or did anything I could see, so there is no new evidence on any individual. No hands were on the table, so hands-off is still holding. Picture: the fish is dark and connected from the nose through the top and bottom curves to the tail join and both tail lobes. The two pale loose dominoes are still at the tail join, off the chain, so they should fall only if the chain knocks them. The tail join is the weak point to watch in the push. I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm rating the team result, not individuals, until I ask.

Tom: Verified the full fish at 5:15 and sensibly left the loose dominoes alone. He credited Leo and called hands off. His bottom curve is strong. Good verification, calm judgment and collaboration. I still haven't seen him build.

Maya: Checked the tail lobes at 5:00, thanked Leo and called hands off. The top curve was her task and is complete, but I never saw her finish it, so I'm crediting it with caution.

Leo: Maya and Tom both credited him for the tail lobes, so a real contribution is likely but unconfirmed. I never saw the right-end join check he promised.

Priya: Silent again. Her early tail split and lower lobe still stand as good initiative and clear communication.

Next: privately ask each person who laid the upper lobe, who finished the top curve and who did the join check. Then watch the push, especially the tail join and the pale pair."}
